source: ECharts 6.1 dist (echarts.js), node SSR, SVG renderer
notes: Every option has animation false; the clock is fake; TZ=UTC.
A step naming a piece points at its shape centre (local) through the group transform, rounded, plus dx / dy.
actions are the axisAreaSelect a parallelAxis view dispatched (api.dispatchAction); an 'action' step's own dispatch is chart.dispatchAction.
The brush component of G-PAN has the toolbox its preprocessor adds on a merge (no buttons).

scenarios.note: horizontal layout, value axes: the crosshair, a cover drawn up axis 1 (realtime: an action every move), its cursors, a second axis, a release away from the last move and the update that lays it back
vertical layout: the axes lie flat; a cover across axis 2, its cursors, its east handle dragged, a tiny drag that clears it
a category axis, a time axis and an inverse value axis: covers on each, the intervals coordToData gives, the rows they leave active

two intervals on one axis by the action (its own view is not rendered: no covers until the next update), the action without a query (the first axis is not rendered), by id, by an index list; a new cover replaces both
a cover moved along its axis, its handles dragged (the west past the east), moved past the axis end: the range leaves the panel, the shape is clipped, the interval clamped

realtime false (parallelAxisDefault): one action at the release, at a dragend, for a click on a cover, for the tiny drag that clears; a realtime axis beside it: a click on its cover dispatches nothing
areaSelectStyle: a 40 px band, an 8 px border, the author's colours and opacity on axis 1; the default on axis 3; handles 8 px wide
globalPan: the parallel's controllers never take it -- an inside dataZoom pans beside them; a brush component taking it stops the pan, not the parallel's brushing

guards.mutation: the panel has no extra at its ends
the handles' cursors ignore the group's turn
realtime read the other way round
an inactive row keeps the full opacity
